arguments.command:
cd /workspace && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import compiler
from compiler import Graph, Builder, build_cutinfo, assemble, verify_plan, make_price

d = json.load(open('tmp/hard32.json'))
links = [tuple(x) for x in d['links']]
env = {int(k): v for k, v in d['env'].items()}
parts = {int(k): v for k, v in d['parts'].items()}
g = Graph(links, env, 1)
cutinfo = build_cutinfo(links, env, 1, parts)
print('constraints:', len(cutinfo['cons']), 'prune cuts:', len(cutinfo['prune']))
for Q in cutinfo['cons']:
    print('  Q size', len(Q))

dem = dict(parts)
base = sorted(dem)
order = sorted(base, key=lambda v: (-dem[v], v))
b = Builder(g, base, dem, cutinfo)

# instrument: monkeypatch _dfs to count stuck points
import collections
stats = collections.Counter()
orig_candidates = Builder.candidates
def cand_wrap(self, root, price):
    out = orig_candidates(self, root, price)
    if not out:
        stats['nocand_%d' % root] += 1
    return out
Builder.candidates = cand_wrap
orig_dfs = Builder._dfs
nodes = [0]
def dfs_wrap(self, order, si):
    nodes[0] += 1
    return orig_dfs(self, order, si)
Builder._dfs = dfs_wrap

t0 = time.time()
ok = b.build(order, 'inv', None, node_budget=3000, deadline=time.time()+20)
print('build ok=%s nodes=%d time=%.1fs' % (ok, nodes[0], time.time()-t0))
print('stuck sources:', dict(stats))
EOF
